subject: Isolate & remove one conversation from logs — compliance follow-up RL-1189
messages:
From: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@skyport.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: remove a single conversation from logs (Case RL-1189)

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the chat yesterday. Per our compliance/legal team's request, we need Redwood to remove one specific conversation that contains PII and contractual attachments from your telemetry and activity logs. The conversation is associated with our account (Skyport Analytics) and the internal reference RL-1189.

I've attached a completed redaction request form and highlighted the thread excerpt in the PDF. We understand this is a targeted request (one thread only) and not a bulk retention change. Please let me know the steps you need from our side to validate and authorize the action (anything like signed consent, identity verification, or DPA addendum).

Appreciate quick confirmation of receipt and an estimated timeline.

Best,
Ana Ruiz
Head of Compliance, Skyport Analytics
[Attachment: redaction_request_form.pdf]
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: remove a single conversation from logs (Case RL-1189)

Hi Karthik / Marissa — forwarding a compliance redaction request from Skyport. They want one specific conversation removed from our telemetry/audit logs (Case RL-1189). Attached form included.

Key asks from Skyport:
- Remove the thread from our activity index and any telemetry used for analytics/observability.
- Provide an audit snapshot of what was removed and a statement they can retain for their records.

Questions for you:
1) What internal checks do we need before we can honor a single-thread redaction (auth, DPO sign-off, DocuSign)?
2) Can we produce a minimal audit artifact showing the record id(s) removed without leaking any extra context?
3) Estimate work/time and any potential impact to retention/metrics.

I'll loop in legal if we need signatures. They indicated urgency but not immediate emergency.

—Grace
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 08:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: remove a single conversation from logs (Case RL-1189)

On Sun, Jan 10, 2027 at 10:05 AM Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Karthik / Marissa — forwarding a compliance redaction request from Skyport.

Thanks Grace. Quick assessment: we can support targeted removal but need a short checklist completed first. Proposed minimal pre-reqs:

- Confirmation of the exact conversation ID(s) to remove (they provided a thread excerpt but we need internal record IDs).
- Signed authorization from an account admin (DocuSign or equivalent).
- Confirmation that removal is limited to logs/telemetry and does not require model weights retraining or dataset deletion (explicit scope).

Operational approach:
1) Once we receive the signed form + record IDs, infra will run a scoped redact job against the telemetry index that removes the conversation document(s) and associated pointers. This job creates a signed audit-snapshot (JSON) listing redacted record IDs and timestamps.
2) Engineering will run validation that metrics/aggregates are consistent post-redaction; any drift will be flagged but is expected to be minimal for single-thread removals.

Estimated timeline: 24–48 business hours after we have signed authorization and precise record IDs. If legal needs to review the wording we can pause.

I'll prepare a redaction job template and the audit snapshot format; Marissa, can you draft the authorization email we should send to Skyport and a DocuSign template?

—Karthik
Principal Reliability Engineer, Runtime
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@skyport.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 14:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: remove a single conversation from logs (Case RL-1189)

Hi Ana — thanks for sending the filled form. We can proceed with an isolated removal for the single conversation under RL-1189. To move forward we need two quick items from you:

1) Please confirm the internal Redwood record ID(s) for the conversation you want removed. If you don't have the Redwood ID, our team can map via the timestamp and participants from your excerpt — let us know which you'd prefer.
2) A signed authorization from a Skyport admin (DocuSign or a scanned signed PDF) authorizing Redwood to remove the specified record(s).

What we'll deliver once complete:
- A signed audit snapshot (attached) showing the redacted record IDs and the UTC timestamps of the operation.
- Confirmation that this action is limited to telemetry/audit indices and does not touch customer-hosted model artifacts.

Next steps: if you can reply with the preferred record-identifiers and attach the signed authorization, we'll queue this for a 24–48 hour redaction job.

Attached is an example audit artifact format we will produce after removal: audit-snapshot-rl1189.json (we will populate it with the actual record IDs when the job runs).

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: audit-snapshot-rl1189.json]

On a related note — Marissa will send the DocuSign template to the Skyport legal contact once Ana confirms how they want to send authorization.
